channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Evening star threatens 216.00 support
item.description: The GBP/JPY failed to sustain the 217.00 breakout, reversing to the 216.50 area as traders faded the move, exacerbating the decline to current exchange rates. At the time of writing, the cross-pair exchanges hands with losses of 0.36%.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar steadies as firm US Dollar caps gains
item.description: NZD/USD is trading around 0.5940 on Tuesday, little changed on the day as the risk-sensitive Kiwi consolidates a strong recovery. The pair has clawed back from its recent lows, but a firm US Dollar (USD) ahead of the Jackson Hole Symposium is keeping a lid on further gains for now.

item.title: Mexican Peso dips as US Core PCE renew Fed hawkish bets
item.description: The Mexican Peso loses some traction against the US Dollar on Wednesday as traders seem confident that the Federal Reserve could raise interest rates toward the end of the year, following a red-hot inflation report. The USD/MXN trades at 16.95, after reaching a daily low of 16.92.

item.title: Japanese Yen slips ahead of Tokyo CPI
item.description: USD/JPY trades around 159.40 on Wednesday, holding onto modest gains as a firmer US Dollar (USD) keeps the pair underpinned. The Dollar is broadly bid ahead of the Jackson Hole Symposium.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: Pace of appreciation against US Dollar seen slowing – ING
item.description: Chris Turner at ING notes USD/CNH is consolidating after last week’s sharp decline, as investors hesitate to buy Renminbi with the PBoC slowing lower USD/CNY fixings and US–Iran sanctions risks in focus.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Range-bound against US Dollar as markets price BoJ hike – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret describe the Japanese Yen (JPY) as quiet, extending a tight consolidation as markets gradually price a 25 bp Bank of Japan (BoJ) hike for September 18.

item.title: Banxico lifts 2026 GDP forecast, delays inflation target return
item.description: On Wednesday, the Bank of Mexico (Banxico) released its Quarterly Report for Q2 2026, in which it revised its forecasts for economic growth and inflation.

item.title: South Korean Won: Appreciation may slow against US Dollar – OCBC
item.description: OCBC Bank strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong observe that USD/KRW has consolidated after sharp declines over the past eight sessions, with exporter and month-end US Dollar (USD) selling offset by a firmer USD tone and foreign equity outflows.

item.title: Emerging Markets: Idiosyncratic bid persists in equities – BNY
item.description: Geoff Yu at BNY highlights that EM EMEA equities have outperformed, with strong buying in Poland, South Africa and Turkey since before the July Fed meeting, despite weaker regional currencies and bonds.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: 160.00 caps bulls as intervention risk lingers
item.description: The USD/JPY pair drifts higher for the third straight day on Wednesday, up a modest 0.11% as buyers reaffirm their control over price action despite uncertainty over another round of intervention by Japanese authorities. The pair trades at 159.38 at the time of writing.

item.title: Euro: Rally stalls against US Dollar as spreads drive trade – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret report the Euro (EUR) is slightly softer versus the Dollar, with its late-July rally stalling as price action mirrors yield spreads.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar firms ahead of Jackson Hole
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) firmed on Wednesday, with the US Dollar Index (DXY) climbing toward 99.20 as traders squared positions ahead of the Jackson Hole Symposium.

item.title: Taiwan Dollar: Consolidation range with upside risks against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Dr. Henry Hao and Charlie Lay highlight that Taiwan’s booming AI-driven exports and strong external surplus create a fundamentally supportive backdrop for the Taiwan Dollar (TWD).

item.title: The Dollar Index is climbing out of a fiscal hole
item.description: The Dollar Index trades just above 99.00 and roughly a quarter of a percent higher, having printed its high just short of 99.25 after 14:00 GMT and not retested it since.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: Further gains toward 6.7000 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report USD/CNH slipped to 6.7166 and closed slightly lower, with short-term downside momentum gradually building.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Bulls eye 1.3900 as RSI recovers
item.description: The USD/CAD pair bounces off daily lows at 1.3833 and is up about 0.26% on Wednesday, driven by sticky US inflation data, which triggered a jump to new weekly highs amid an ongoing short-term downturn. At the time of writing, the pair trades at 1.3873.

item.title: Gold tumbles as high US inflation supports Fed hawkish bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) price drops over 1.37% on Wednesday as economic data from the United States (US) broadly aligned with estimates. Meanwhile, inflation remains close to the 4% threshold, increasing the likelihood of higher interest rates.

item.title: Crude Oil finds the tollbooth inside the Hormuz corridor
item.description: Crude Oil trades just above $82.00 and 1.78% higher on the session, which is not where it was heading.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Tariff headlines but range intact against US Dollar – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret highlight that the Canadian Dollar (CAD) is slightly softer, tracking broader USD gains and weaker Oil, while USD/CAD trades almost exactly at their fair value estimate near 1.3862.

item.title: Swiss Franc falls against US Dollar as headline PCE inflation tops forecasts
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) weakens against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday as the Greenback attracts buyers following the release of the latest United States (US) inflation data. Traders also remain attentive to developments in the Middle East.

item.title: British Pound retreats as sticky PCE inflation keeps Fed hike bets alive
item.description: The Pound Sterling (GBP) retreats about 0.39% on Wednesday as the US Dollar (USD) stages a recovery after a US inflation report showed prices remain elevated, keeping the chances of a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike toward the end of the year.

item.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average ignores a revision made of inflation
item.description: The Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) trades a shade beneath 53,500 and roughly 100 points lower in the session on Wednesday, after a 12:30 GMT data drop the wires filed as uneventful.

item.title: Euro firms against British Pound on hopes of a Hormuz deal
item.description: EUR/GBP is trading around 0.8570 on Wednesday, on the front foot as hopes of a de-escalation in the Gulf hand the Euro (EUR) a modest lift.

item.title: Reserve Bank of Australia: Preemptive hike debate intensifies – TD Securities
item.description: Prashant Newnaha at TD Securities notes that the RBA’s August minutes were overall less hawkish than June, but still emphasized upside inflation risks and the possibility of preemptive tightening.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar dips, but RBNZ hike bets provide safety net
item.description: NZD/USD retreats to around 0.5940 on Wednesday at the time of writing, down 0.60% on the day. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) loses ground against the US Dollar (USD), which finds some support following the release of the latest United States (US) inflation data.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: Buyers struggle below the 100-day SMA
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) comes under selling pressure on Wednesday as the US Dollar (USD) strengthens following the latest United States (US) inflation data. At the time of writing, XAG/USD trades around $67.79, down nearly 1.26% on the day.

item.title: Polish Zloty: Policy divergence weighs on PLN against Euro – ABN AMRO
item.description: ABN AMRO’s Georgette Boele highlights that EUR/PLN has risen as interest rate expectations diverge between the Eurozone and Poland.

item.title: Australian Dollar stumbles as hot Australian CPI runs into a firmer US Dollar
item.description: AUD/USD is trading around 0.7170 on Wednesday, down slightly after a hot Australian inflation print ran straight into a firmer US Dollar.

item.title: Taiwan: AI boom sustains exceptional growth – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Dr. Henry Hao and Charlie Lay underscore that Taiwan’s industrial production and exports are surging on AI and high-performance computing demand. July manufacturing output and export orders point to Q3 GDP growth around 12–12.5% year-on-year, after 12.9% in Q2.

item.title: Canadian Dollar falls despite Oil gains as trade tensions take center stage
item.description: USD/CAD rises 0.30% on Wednesday, trading around 1.3880 at the time of writing.
